introduction.value: A Zillow scraper feeds Claude to produce daily briefs on new listings, price cuts and outreach scripts, emailed to 47 paying real estate agents.

method.value: A Zillow scraper feeds yesterday's listings into Claude each morning. Email daily deal briefs from Zillow listings to real estate agents
A Zillow scraper feeds Claude to produce daily briefs on new listings, price cuts and outreach scripts, emailed to 47 paying real estate agents.
Done with
CL
Claude
What they did
A Zillow scraper feeds yesterday's listings into Claude each morning. Claude generates a one-page Deal Intel Brief listing five same-day showings, price cuts that indicate motivated sellers, and three copy-paste outreach scripts. The finished brief is emailed automatically at 6:45am; the operator only manages subscriptions and sales.
How it went
47 agents pay $149 monthly, producing $10,237 in revenue last month at a total stack cost of $74. No shortfalls are stated.
Worth knowing
The entire stack costs $74 per month.
Try it yourself
with
n8n
Copy prompt
Build an n8n workflow that runs every morning: pull new listings and price cuts in [market] from [data source], have an AI step write a short brief with top deals and a sample outreach script for each, and email it to my subscriber list in [email tool]. Send the first run to me only as a test, and wait for my go-ahead before it emails the full list.
